assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an actual transparent PNG UI material skin for a tall television app sidebar, NOT a mockup. Create ONE tall vertical rounded rectangle of optically clear liquid glass on a genuinely transparent canvas, aspect ratio about 1:4, front-facing orthographic view. The whole glass shape nearly fills the canvas with only 3 percent clear margin. Rounded corners about 18 percent of its width. Premium Apple-inspired liquid-glass craftsmanship: a visibly thick yet elegant convex glass edge, fluid continuous silver-white specular highlights hugging the upper-left rim and lower-right rim, delicate cool cyan/blue optical refraction only along the edges, soft inner caustic reflections, polished luminous corners, extremely smooth clean gradients. The broad flat center must remain almost completely transparent (roughly 85-95 percent transparent) so the real app background and text remain readable through it. Glass should feel clear, wet, luminous and dimensional, NOT matte frosted plastic, NOT a filled grey panel, NOT metal. Very subtle soft shadow only around the outside. No background scene, no checkerboard pattern baked in, no text, no icons, no symbols, no logos, no water droplets, no bubbles, no scratches, no grain, no glitter. One seamless isolated reusable glass surface only. Preserve true alpha transparency throughout the open center and outside.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: an actual transparent PNG UI material skin for a premium TV app pill button, NOT a mockup. ONE horizontal liquid-glass capsule, front-facing orthographic view, width to height about 3.4:1, occupies almost the entire canvas with 4 percent transparent margin. Fully rounded semicircular ends. Optically clear convex crystal lens with a beautifully continuous softly glowing silver-white edge, bright clean specular crescent along the upper-left shoulder, a more subtle lower-right edge glint, tiny cool cyan highlights from refraction only at the perimeter, a very soft inner reflection that implies fluid rounded thickness. The center is flat, calm and largely transparent, about 80-90 percent transparent, with faint smoky-clear glass tint only, leaving room for app text and an icon. Visible optical depth and smooth luminous bevel, no coarse texture. Subtle soft exterior shadow. Do not make an opaque white or grey pill, plastic button, chrome metal badge, neon outline, or literal blob of water. No text, no icons, no symbols, no logo, no background image, no baked checkerboard, no droplets, no bubbles, no particles, no grain. Transparent alpha background and genuinely translucent center. A single reusable production UI skin only.

Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual transparent PNG liquid-glass overlay skin for a television video player's bottom control panel. ONE wide horizontal rounded rectangle, width to height about 5:1, front-facing orthographic view, fills most of a wide canvas with 3 percent clear margin. Corner radius about 22 percent of the panel height. The geometry is a polished soft convex optical glass lens, beautifully smooth flowing edge reflections, clear luminous silver-white upper-left rim, subtle cool blue/cyan refraction and an elegant lower-right caustic highlight that gives dimensional fluid thickness. The material should evoke an exceptionally refined Apple-style liquid-glass control panel. The broad center is nearly transparent (85-95 percent transparent) and very subtly smoky-neutral, so the actual video underneath can remain visible. Reflections and refraction concentrate at the perimeter, with a very faint soft glossy veil across the top quarter. Clean smooth gradients and precision edges, slight exterior ambient shadow. It must be a practical clear glass overlay, NOT a UI screenshot, NOT frosted matte grey, NOT an opaque metal panel, NOT a white slab, NOT a wire outline, NOT literal water. No text, icons, timeline, controls, symbols, logos, scene, baked checkerboard, noise, scratches, grain, droplets, or bubbles. True alpha transparency outside and across the central glass surface.

capsule_refinement: Edit only the glass transparency of this existing capsule UI skin.
